nodes.label: Pi-hole
nodes.detail: DNS filtering for the house. A secondary resolver sits behind it so the Pi is not a single point of failure for name resolution.

nodes.label: Hermes
nodes.detail: Always-on orchestrator. Receives instructions, routes work, returns results.

nodes.label: Hermes workspace
nodes.detail: Acts as the MCP sender — the bridge between the orchestrator and tools on the workstation.

nodes.label: Discord gateway
nodes.detail: Away-from-desk surface. Tasks go in and results come back without opening a laptop.

nodes.label: Mnemosyne
nodes.detail: Central memory server for the whole stack. One store, deliberately not co-located with inference.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.detail: Dashboards for host and service health, fed by cron-driven checks.

nodes.label: cron
nodes.detail: Maintenance and health checks on a schedule.

nodes.label: Tailscale
nodes.detail: Mesh fabric joining every host. Remote maintenance without exposing anything to the internet.

nodes.label: OpenCode
nodes.detail: Heavily customised, with a bespoke AGENTS.md and Oh My OpenCode for subagents. Fan-out capped at 4.

nodes.label: llama-swap
nodes.detail: All models in one group, so exactly one is resident on the GPU at any moment. Mutual exclusion is enforced, not maintained by hand. The group holds further configured members not in use at present.

nodes.label: NInfer · Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored
nodes.detail: Primary text model for adversarial testing and vulnerability discovery.

nodes.label: NInfer · Ornith-1.5-35B DFlash
nodes.detail: Text and coding inference with DFlash speculation; cannot serve images. Recorded measurements: roughly 585 tok/s decode throughput, 47% draft acceptance, and 4.30 tokens per round.

nodes.label: vLLM · Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B
nodes.detail: NVFP4 inference model on vLLM. Swapped in rather than run alongside the other group members.

nodes.label: ComfyUI
nodes.detail: Vision and diffusion models for diagrams and imagery. Also under llama-swap, so it cannot take VRAM behind the manager's back.

nodes.label: Langfuse
nodes.detail: Full tracing across agent runs. Latency spikes that do not track token counts are usually a model swap.

nodes.label: OpenSpec
nodes.detail: Specs drive the work. Changes start as a written spec, not a prompt.

nodes.label: n8n
nodes.detail: Containerised on the Pi with its own internal cron, separate from the host crontab. Reads the 08:30 output at 08:45 and renders it to HTML.

nodes.label: Digest job
nodes.detail: Fires at 08:30, hands the day's threat intel to Claude Cowork, and writes the returned briefing to local files. Not gated by llama-swap — the inference happens off-box.

nodes.label: Claude Cowork
nodes.detail: Hosted model, currently doing the daily briefing generation. Being ported to local inference — the one remaining external dependency in the pipeline.

nodes.label: Resend
nodes.detail: Third-party transactional send from send.nv-sec.com, SPF/DKIM/DMARC verified.

nodes.label: Work inbox
nodes.detail: Where the morning briefing lands at 08:45.

nodes.label: Phone / laptop
nodes.detail: Joins the tailnet from anywhere. No ports open.
